name: When is stucco texture matching recommended versus re-stuccoing the entire wall?
description: Matching is for localized repairs on otherwise good stucco; re-stuccoing is for widespread damage, discoloration, or a full aesthetic change.

mainEntity.name: When is stucco texture matching recommended versus re-stuccoing the entire wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco texture matching is recommended when the damage or new addition is localized, and the majority of the existing stucco is in good condition. It's a cost-effective solution for minor repairs, patches, or small extensions. Re-stuccoing an entire wall or property is typically considered when there's widespread damage, significant discoloration, or if you desire a complete change in color or texture for aesthetic reasons. The decision balances cost, extent of damage, and desired outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Matching is for localized repairs on otherwise good stucco; re-stuccoing is for widespread damage, discoloration, or a full aesthetic change.
